'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Cole Lepine LS Heading For The Medical Frigate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''MR. T'''. Username '''clepine'''. Line 1 Yavin 4: Throne Room; start [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]] at L2. L8 Fanfare struck → Houjix & Out Of Nowhere (V). L30 Naked 3PO → C-3PO (See-Threepio). L33 Padme rewritten → Bron Burs (V). L43 Inconsequential Barriers struck → Desperate Reach. Shield10 Wise Advice struck → Do, Or Do Not.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Username:''' clepine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
